description: Interface defining file system operations and database record updates for Drupal's file module.

classes.name: FileRepositoryInterface
classes.description: Defines methods for file operations such as writing, copying, moving, and loading files within Drupal.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Writes data to a specified destination URI, updating or creating a file entity.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file entity to a new location and updates the database record.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves a file entity to a new location and updates the database record.

methods.name: loadByUri
methods.description: Loads the first file entity matching a given URI.
